components.name: Accordion/BodyPlaceholder
components.description: Plain component (NOT a variant set) that exists only because 21.2 makes `bodySlot` an INSTANCE_SWAP whose default is `Accordion/BodyPlaceholder`, and an INSTANCE_SWAP default must be a real component - a blank frame default hides layout bugs (0.9). It is one FILL x HUG vertical frame holding a single body-copy text layer in Latin/Mobile/body (15/400/160%), color/text/primary, auto-height, unbounded wrap (the panel height is never clamped - 21.7). Real panels swap it for a Tier-2 composition (delivery-charge table, FAQ rich text, the checkout address form).

components.name: Tabs/Item
components.description: One tab in a tablist (role=tab). 2 Variants x 3 States = 6. WHY Active is an axis: exactly one tab is active at all times and a PDP or order-board mockup must show it; hover/pressed/focus-visible are interaction-only (0.3). WHY Disabled is an axis and keeps its _focus ring: a disabled tab is aria-disabled, stays in the arrow-key sequence and remains focusable so its existence is discoverable (20.9) - it is NOT removed from the tab order like a disabled button. Underline: height FIXED 44, padding X space/4, min-width 72, radius none; the active indicator is the token-bound RECTANGLE `_indicator` (2px, full item width, radius/full, color/bg/brand, Ignore auto-layout, pinned to the bottom edge), never a stroke on the frame - a bottom stroke could not be animated between tabs, would not sit above the list's 1px rule, and could not be hidden per state without changing the frame. Pill: radius/full, no indicator - the color/bg/surface fill plus Elevation e1 IS the indicator, inside a color/bg/subtle track owned by the `Tabs / Pill` layout frame. Hover is a FILL SWAP, not the scrim: Underline hover = color/bg/subtle with radius/md on the top two corners only (so the hover shape does not cross the bottom rule); Pill hover = color/bg/surface. The `_scrim` layer is kept for pressed (12%) only. Label is a single line with white-space: nowrap (textAutoResize WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT) - a tab label never wraps and never truncates; the LIST scrolls (0.7 SCROLL strategy). Count is a 20-tall radius/full pill with the count in Latin/Badge (12/600); it is aria-hidden and the count is folded into the accessible name ('Reviews, 128 items'). NEVER: FILL-width items (equal-width tabs force the shortest label to carry the longest Bangla box and overflow the viewport - the only exception is the two-tab Drawer footer, a documented instance), never a 'More' dropdown, never a second row. Bangla: GROW per item, SCROLL for the list - `বয়স নির্দেশিকা` is 152px vs `Age guidance` 130px, and both PDP tab sets (612 / 600px) overflow 390px, so the scroller is the same case in both locales, not a Bangla special case.

documentationInstances.label: Bangla long-string
documentationInstances.expected: Item hugs to ~152px wide (vs 130 for 'Age guidance'); one line, 44 tall, nothing wraps or truncates. Place it inside a 358px-wide copy of the `Tabs` layout frame to show the list clipping (SCROLL).

components.name: Accordion/Item
components.description: One disclosure section: a <button aria-expanded> inside a heading, plus a region panel. 2 Variants x 3 States = 6. WHY Expanded is an axis: open/closed is discrete content state and a mockup must show both; hover/pressed/focus-visible stay interaction-only. The ENTIRE Header row is the button (>=56 tall x FILL wide) - the chevron is decorative (aria-hidden) and inside that single target; a chevron-only hit area is the classic accordion defect. Header is HUG height with Min height 56, NOT a fixed 56: a two-line Bangla title (`বয়স নির্দেশিকা ও নিরাপত্তা তথ্য` at Bangla/Mobile/h4 = 24.8px/line -> 50px block -> 82px header) grows the header rather than overflowing it. TextBlock is FILL and absorbs the loss; Leading, BadgeSlot and Chevron are HUG/FIXED and keep their widths. Titles wrap (textAutoResize HEIGHT, no maxLines); three title lines is a content defect, capped at 40 Bangla characters. Chevron is icon/caret-down and the open state is `rotation: 180` on that icon layer (0 -> 180 over base 200ms standard); reduced motion = no rotation, the glyph swaps to caret-up. Title weight steps 600 (Latin/Mobile/h4) -> 700 (Latin/Accordion/Title-Expanded) on expand per 21.3. Boxed: color/bg/surface, 1px color/border/default INSIDE, radius/lg - a border rather than e1 because dark mode substitutes a border for e1 anyway and one binding beats two. Flush: no fill, no radius, an in-flow 1px `_divider` at the bottom (hidden on the last item by the layout frame). Disabled: still rendered, still focusable (aria-disabled), used for checkout sections not yet reachable - so it KEEPS `_focus`; text and chevron go color/text/disabled, Boxed fill goes color/bg/disabled, and `_scrim` is removed. Panel is FILL x HUG, padding X/bottom space/4, top 0 (the header's bottom padding supplies the gap), and holds the `bodySlot` instance; it is hidden with the `hidden` attribute in code, never height:0 - otherwise focusable children stay reachable by Tab. NEVER: arrow keys between headers (an accordion is not a tablist; hijacking arrows breaks PDP scrolling), spring easing, a chevron-only target, a clamped panel. Checkout rule (21.5): Variant=Flush, allowMultiple=false, no icon/badge, numbered title prefix '1. Contact & delivery', a completed section shows a 20px icon/check in color/status/in-stock and nothing more.

components.name: Stepper/Step
components.description: One step of a progress stepper (an <li> in an ordered list inside <nav aria-label>). 2 Orientations x 2 Variants x 4 States = 16. WHY State is an axis: Complete / Current / Upcoming / Error are discrete content states, each with a distinct SHAPE so state is never carried by colour alone - Complete is a filled circle with a check, Current an outlined circle with a number, Upcoming a muted outlined circle with a number, Error an outlined circle with an alert glyph; Current additionally carries weight 700 (Latin/Stepper/Label-Current). WHY Orientation is an axis here although 30.1 puts it on the frame: the step's own auto-layout direction changes (indicator ABOVE the label, centred, in a Horizontal stepper; indicator LEFT of the label in a Vertical stepper) and Figma cannot override an instance's layout direction, so the `Stepper` layout frames pick the matching Orientation value. In the Vertical orientation the connector lives INSIDE the step's 28px Rail as a FILL-height 2px rectangle, so it stretches to whatever height a wrapped Bangla label produces - which is why Vertical handles long labels for free. In the Horizontal orientation the connector is a sibling layer of the `Stepper` layout frame. Numbered indicator 28x28 radius/full: Complete color/bg/brand + 16px icon/check in color/text/on-brand; Current color/bg/surface + 2px color/border/brand ring + number; Upcoming color/bg/subtle + 2px color/border/default + number in color/text/tertiary; Error color/bg/surface + 2px color/border/danger + 16px icon/warning-circle in color/feedback/danger. Number is Latin/Stepper/Number (12/700, tabular) and is aria-hidden. Dot indicator: a 28px wrapper (so connectors centre identically) holding a 20px Ring (filled color/bg/brand-subtle only on Current) around a 12px Dot. Interaction: steps are NON-INTERACTIVE by default. Only a Complete step may be a button (jump back to edit), so only Complete variants carry `_focus` (whole step, radius/md) and a `_scrim` on the indicator. Current, Upcoming and Error are NEVER clickable - jumping forward past an incomplete step is how a checkout loses an address. The indicator alone is never a target (28px). Label: Horizontal = 14/600 centred, wraps to 2 lines inside the 88 min-width (16 Bangla characters cap; three lines is a content defect, not a layout case); Vertical = left-aligned, FILL, unbounded. Description (caption, Vertical-only in practice) carries the failure in words on Error ('Card declined') - the red ring is never the only signal; the page also renders an Alert. Checkout rule (30.5): Variant=Numbered, Orientation=Horizontal, three steps, no description; completion produces a check mark and a filled connector and nothing else - no spring, no bounce, no scale, no confetti, no sound.

layoutFrames.name: Tabs
layoutFrames.description: PDP tab set at mobile width (390): Description [Active] / Specifications / Age guidance / Reviews (128). TabList is FILL x FIXED 44 with CLIP CONTENT TRUE and the 16px page gutter INSIDE it as padding (layout/gutter-mobile) - the clip IS the horizontal scroller (overflow-x: auto, scroll-snap-type: x proximity, scrollbar hidden), so the list clips at the right edge and the Reviews item is partly cut, which is the intended SCROLL demonstration (612px of items in 358px). Primary axis is MIN (packed left), never Space-between or Center; items are HUG width, never FILL. Layer order inside TabList, bottom to top: `_rule` (1px color/border/default, Ignore auto-layout, pinned left/right/bottom, full 390 width, sits BEHIND the active `_indicator` which paints over it inside the item), the four items, then `_fade` (24px right-edge gradient to color/bg/canvas, Ignore auto-layout, pinned right/top/bottom, pointer-events none, aria-hidden) - the overflow affordance, shown only while more content exists. TabPanel is FILL x HUG with padding-top space/6 and the page gutter left/right; role=tabpanel, tabindex=0, labelled by the active tab. Indicator geometry: 2px bar, full item width, radius/full, bottom edge of the 44px item; it slides between tabs over base 200ms standard as a shared layout transition (not a per-tab fade); reduced motion jumps.

layoutFrames.name: Tabs / Pill
layoutFrames.description: Admin dashboard period switch - the ONLY sanctioned use of Variant=Pill (tabs on a tinted surface that need their own container). Track: HORIZONTAL, HUG x HUG, padding space/1 on all sides, gap space/2, fill color/bg/subtle, radius/full, clip content false. Items: Today / 7 days [Active] / 30 days / Custom, each HUG x FIXED 44; the active item carries color/bg/surface + Elevation/Light/e1 - the fill is the indicator, there is no bar and no bottom rule. The active pill slides between items over base 200ms standard (shared layout transition); reduced motion jumps. Desktop-only surface, so no scroller: four short labels fit.

layoutFrames.name: Accordion
layoutFrames.description:
PDP 'Delivery & returns' FAQ group, Variant=Boxed, allowMultiple=true (a parent reads delivery and age guidance together), at the 358px mobile content width. VERTICAL, FILL x HUG, gap space/3 (12) between Boxed items, no fill, no padding. Three items: 'Delivery & returns' EXPANDED with subtitle '2–3 days inside Dhaka' and leading icon/truck; 'Cash on delivery' collapsed with leading icon/credit-card; 'Age guidance & safety' collapsed with a Badge Type=Verified in the BadgeSlot. Each header is one

; each panel is role=region aria-labelledby the button and uses the hidden attribute when closed. No live region on toggle.

layoutFrames.name: Accordion / Checkout
layoutFrames.description: The checkout's three sections under the 21.5 checkout rule: Variant=Flush, allowMultiple=false, no badge, numbered title prefixes, no colour celebration. VERTICAL, FILL x HUG, gap 0 (Flush items carry their own 1px bottom `_divider`; the LAST item's `_divider` is toggled hidden as a direct layer override - legal, no property owns it). Item 1 '1. Contact & delivery' is Collapsed with showLeading=true, leadingSwap=icon/check and the Leading icon's FILL overridden to color/status/in-stock - the one permitted completion signal, nothing more. Item 2 '2. Delivery method & charge' is Expanded (its bodySlot is the BodyPlaceholder; in Tier 2 it is the delivery-method Radio/Card group). Item 3 '3. Payment & review' is Disabled - still rendered and focusable with aria-disabled so the shopper learns the section exists. Headings are <h2> on checkout. Only the base 200ms height transition is permitted here; no rotation easing beyond standard, no spring.

layoutFrames.name: Stepper
layoutFrames.description: The checkout stepper (30.5): Orientation=Horizontal, Variant=Numbered, three steps, no description, at the 358px mobile content width. HORIZONTAL, FILL x HUG, gap space/2, counter axis TOP (MIN) - so a two-line label on one step never pushes the other indicators down; all indicators stay on one line. Children in order: Step 1 'Contact & delivery' [Complete] -> ConnectorSlot (color/bg/brand, the connector AFTER a Complete step) -> Step 2 'Delivery method' [Current] -> ConnectorSlot (color/border/default) -> Step 3 'Payment & review' [Upcoming]; plus the visually-hidden `_sr-status` 'Step 2 of 3: Delivery method' (aria-live=polite, updated on advance). Connector geometry: each `_connector` is a FILL x FIXED 2 rectangle, radius/full, centred vertically inside a FILL x FIXED 28 `ConnectorSlot` (counter CENTER) so it meets the 28px indicators' centres at y=13 without a typed margin; the slot sits at the frame's top because the frame is top-aligned. Width arithmetic at 358: steps clamp at their 88 min-width, the two FILL slots take (358 - 264 - 32) / 2 = 31 each. Steps 1-3 are the shopper's real checkout; only Step 1 (Complete) is a button ('Step 1, Contact and delivery, completed. Edit.'); Step 2 carries aria-current=step; Step 3 is a span. Connectors are aria-hidden. Motion on advance: indicator crossfade + check draw over fast 120ms, connector fills left-to-right over base 200ms standard; reduced motion instant. No spring, no scale, no confetti.

layoutFrames.name: Stepper / Vertical
layoutFrames.description: Four-step checkout with descriptions on mobile (<768px) - the 30.6 orientation rule forces Vertical (4 x 88 + 3 x 8 = 376px does not fit 358). VERTICAL, FILL x HUG, gap space/2 (the 8px BELOW each connector; the 8px ABOVE it is the Rail's gap), no fill. Each step is Orientation=Vertical with its own in-rail FILL-height `_connector`; the last step sets showConnector=false. Rows: 1 'Contact & delivery' [Complete] description 'Tanzila Akter · Savar, Dhaka'; 2 'Delivery method' [Complete] 'Standard · ৳80 · 2–3 days'; 3 'Payment' [ERROR] 'Card declined – try again or choose cash on delivery' (the failure in words; the page also shows an Alert Type=Danger); 4 'Review & place order' [Upcoming] 'Check everything before you confirm'. `_sr-status` reads 'Step 3 of 4: Payment'. Every row is min-height 56 and HUGs taller when a Bangla description wraps; the rail's connector stretches to match, which is the whole reason Vertical is the long-label orientation.

overrides.label: Payment
overrides.description: Card declined – try again or choose cash on delivery

layoutFrames.name: Stepper / Dot
layoutFrames.description: Order-tracking timeline preview at desktop width (560): Orientation=Horizontal, Variant=Dot, four shipment statuses Placed [Complete] -> Packed [Complete] -> Shipped [Current] -> Delivered [Upcoming]. Shows the Dot ring (20px color/bg/brand-subtle around the 12px color/bg/brand dot on Current) and that Dot indicators sit in the same 28px wrapper so the ConnectorSlots centre identically. Same frame rules as `Stepper`: HORIZONTAL, FILL x HUG, gap space/2, counter TOP; FILL steps clamp at 88, three FILL slots share the rest ((560 - 352 - 48) / 3 = 53 each). On mobile this component switches to Vertical (4 steps, 30.6).

notes: CONVENTION / descriptor keys. This manifest uses the batch-2 frame/layer keys DIRECTLY: clipsContent, primaryAxisAlign, counterAxisAlign (MIN|CENTER|MAX|SPACE_BETWEEN), minWidth, minHeight, rotation (degrees, on the icon layer), opacity (layer opacity 0-100), textAlign (LEFT|CENTER), textAutoResize (WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT = single line / nowrap, HEIGHT = fixed width + wrap, NONE = fixed box) and maxLines (always null here - nothing truncates). A STRING on gap / padding / size-like fields is a variable to BIND (space/*, layout/gutter-mobile, border-width/*); a NUMBER is a raw px value. fillToken/strokeToken null = remove the paint. strokeWeight 0 = no stroke. absolute.inset {t,r,b,l}: null = unconstrained edge; constraints are written 'H/V' as in manifest 04. Later children paint on top, so every _scrim and _focus is declared last in its host.

CONVENTION / sizing of a FILL-width component. 'sizing.h: FILL' on a component's own root (Accordion/Item, Stepper/Step Vertical, Accordion/BodyPlaceholder) means 'Fill container' when instanced; on the master, resize to the stated size.w (358 / 326) and leave the horizontal sizing as FIXED - exactly as manifest 04 did for Switch (FILL x HUG at 320).

CONVENTION / per-corner radius. The descriptor has one cornerRadiusToken. Tabs/Item (Underline) `_scrim` carries radius/md on the TOP-LEFT and TOP-RIGHT corners only and radius/none on the bottom two (20.4: the hover shape must not cross the bottom rule) - set the four corner radii individually and bind the two top ones. Accordion/Item (Boxed) Header carries radius/lg on all four corners when Collapsed/Disabled (the header is the whole item) and on the TOP two only when Expanded (the panel sits below it). Nowhere else is a per-corner radius used.

CONVENTION / gradient with stop opacity. Tabs `TabList/_fade` fillToken is 'gradient:linear 90deg | color/bg/canvas@0% 0% -> color/bg/canvas@100% 100%': the '@N%' after a token is that STOP's opacity. Build a GRADIENT_LINEAR paint left-to-right (90deg) with two stops both bound to color/bg/canvas, the left stop at alpha 0 and the right stop at alpha 1. It is the CSS `linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--color-bg-canvas))` right-edge fade; width 24 = space/6 (bind it).

CONVENTION / connector centring (Stepper, Horizontal). 30.7 asks for a `margin-top: 13px` on the connector. Figma has no margin and 13 is not a token, so each horizontal `_connector` (FILL x FIXED 2, radius/full) sits inside a `ConnectorSlot` frame (FILL x FIXED 28, counter axis CENTER, fill null); the slot is the same height as the indicator and the Stepper frame is top-aligned, so the bar lands at y=13..15 by alignment, not by a typed offset. In CSS this is `align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 13px` on a 2px bar - same result.

CONVENTION / COMPONENT_INSTANCE non-property overrides. Three layout-frame instances need an override that no exposed property owns; each is a legal direct layer override on the instance: (1) `Accordion / Checkout` > Item/1 > Header/Leading: FILL -> color/status/in-stock (the completed-section check). (2) `Accordion / Checkout` > Item/3 > `_divider`: visible -> false (last Flush item, 21.3). (3) `Accordion` (Boxed) needs none - Boxed items have no divider. Everything else on an instance goes through setProperties.

CONFLICT / Disabled palette (brief decision 6 vs spec 20.4 / 21.4 / 0.4). Text, icon and chevron on every Disabled variant bind color/text/disabled (brief), NOT color/text/tertiary (spec). Fills: Accordion/Item Boxed Disabled binds color/bg/disabled (brief) in place of the spec's color/bg/subtle. Tabs/Item Disabled keeps fill NONE in both Variants and Accordion/Item Flush Disabled keeps fill NONE: 20.4 and 21.4 explicitly give those cells no fill, and a filled disabled Pill tab would be indistinguishable from the Pill Active/hover fill - decision 6 governs WHICH disabled tokens are used, not whether a fill exists. The Tabs Count pill on Disabled binds color/bg/disabled + color/text/disabled. `_scrim` is removed (visible:false) on every Disabled variant per 0.4.

CONFLICT / Stepper Orientation is a THIRD AXIS on Stepper/Step (16 variants), not a frame-only concern as 30.1 states. Reason: 30.3 gives the step a different auto-layout direction per orientation (indicator above vs left of the label, centred vs left text) and Figma cannot override an instance's layout direction, child order or text alignment. Nothing on the step is interaction state, so binding decision 5 is not violated. Each `Stepper*` layout frame uses only its own Orientation value. The Vertical variant also owns the `_connector` inside its Rail (30.7), which is why `showConnector` exists on the set and has no effect on Horizontal variants (same pattern as Divider.showLabel on Vertical in manifest 05).

CONFLICT / `srStatus` (30.2) is specified as a component property on the `Stepper` FRAME. A plain layout frame cannot carry component properties, and the brief places Stepper under layoutFrames. Each Stepper layout frame therefore carries `_sr-status` as a 1x1, no-fill, opacity-0 TEXT layer with its characters typed directly ('Step 2 of 3: Delivery method'); edit the text, not a property. If the lead later promotes `Stepper` to a component, add TEXT property `srStatus` bound to `_sr-status`.characters then. In code it is a visually-hidden

; the Bangla string uses Bengali numerals ('ধাপ ২ / ৩') because it is read aloud, never displayed.

CONFLICT / Accordion/Item Boxed clip content is FALSE, not TRUE as 21.6 states. `_focus` sits 4px outside the Header, whose top edge is the item's top edge; a clipping item would shear the ring's top and sides. The clip was wanted so the header hover fill follows the item's rounded corners - that is delivered instead by the Header's own radius/lg corners (see the per-corner note). Nothing else in a Boxed item overflows.

CONFLICT / spec-internal, Tabs list padding. 20.3 says list padding X = 0 ('the page gutter supplies it') while 20.6 says the 16px gutter lives INSIDE the scroll container as padding-inline, because a gutter on a parent clips the scroll. 20.6 is the operative rule on mobile and the `Tabs` layout frame binds padding l/r = layout/gutter-mobile on TabList and TabPanel. On desktop (no scroller) the same frame can take padding 0 inside a gutted parent; both are instance-level, no variant.

CONFLICT / spec-internal, Stepper vertical gap. 30.3 says gap between steps space/2 (8) in both orientations; 30.7's vertical tree says gap 0. Built with space/2: the connector needs 8px ABOVE it (the Rail's gap) and 8px BELOW it (the frame gap) per 30.3's own connector row, and gap 0 would butt the connector into the next indicator.

DECISION / border tokens on Stepper indicators. 30.4 writes the Current ring as 2px color/bg/brand and the Error ring as 2px color/feedback/danger. This manifest binds color/border/brand and color/border/danger - the system has dedicated border tokens of the same hue, and a stroke should bind a border token so a future retune of the fill scale does not move a ring. The Dot variant's Error dot has no spec colour; it binds color/feedback/danger to match the Numbered Error glyph, and the Upcoming dot binds color/border/default as 30.4 states.

DECISION / text style mapping. Exact matches used as-is: Latin/Mobile/h4 (Accordion Title Collapsed/Disabled, 16/600/135), Latin/Mobile/body-sm (Accordion Subtitle, 14/400/150), Latin/Mobile/body (Accordion panel body + Tabs panel, 15/400/160), Latin/Badge (Tabs Count text - 11.3 defines it as 12/600 caption metrics, exactly what 20.3 asks for the count). Stepper Description binds Latin/Mobile/caption (12/500/140) although 30.3 writes 12/400: the foundations type scale (01-foundations 5.2) fixes `caption` at 500 for all metadata and a near-duplicate 12/400 style would be the only 400-weight caption in the system - the 100-weight difference is not worth a 13th style. Everything else that has no match is listed under newTextStyles (6 Latin + 5 Bangla; Stepper/Number has no Bangla twin because numerals are Western in both locales).

DECISION / Accordion `badgeSwap` default. 21.2 gives the default as `Badge`, which is a 7-variant set; an INSTANCE_SWAP default must be one component, so BadgeSlot is placed as Badge Type=FreeDelivery (its 'Free delivery' label is the natural companion of the 'Delivery & returns' title). Swapping to any other Badge variant is the property's purpose. The `Accordion` layout frame swaps item 3 to Type=Verified.

DECISION / Accordion Leading icon colour. 21.4 gives no token for the optional leading icon. It binds color/text/secondary on Collapsed and Expanded (metadata weight, so the title stays the loudest element) and color/text/disabled on Disabled. The checkout's completed-section check overrides it to color/status/in-stock on the instance (21.5).

DECISION / Tabs/Item is FIXED 44 tall on the master. 20.5 writes the item as 'HUG x FILL' inside a FIXED-44 TabList; FILL and FIXED 44 render identically there, and FIXED 44 keeps a standalone item (e.g. in the Pill track, which is HUG) at the spec height. Vertical padding is 0 with counter CENTER per 0.6. Horizontal sizing is HUG with Min width 72.

DERIVE: Tabs/Item rendered widths. The size.w values (118 for 'Description', and 142 / 130 / 150 for the other PDP labels, 30 for the Count pill) are the spec's Plus Jakarta Sans measurements; Hanken Grotesk SemiBold/Bold will differ by a few px. Items are HUG, so read each item's absoluteBoundingBox after the fonts are applied before computing the `Tabs` frame's overflow and before grid-placing the set. The overflow demonstration holds regardless (about 612px of items in a 358px clip).

DERIVE: Accordion/Item footprints. Collapsed = header only (56 at minHeight; 54 of content so the minimum bites). Expanded = header 56 + panel (BodyPlaceholder text + space/4 bottom padding) - estimated 88, so 144 (Boxed) / 145 (Flush, with the in-flow 1px `_divider`). The panel height depends on how the 2-sentence placeholder wraps at 326px in Latin/Mobile/body; read it from absoluteBoundingBox and place the Expanded variants with >= 40px clearance using the LIVE height, not 144. Bangla documentation instances will be taller still (27.6px lines).

DERIVE: Stepper/Step Horizontal heights. 78 assumes the default 'Delivery method' wraps to 2 lines at 88px (28 + 8 + 2 x 21). 'Contact & delivery' and 'Payment & review' also wrap; one-word labels (Dot timeline) give 57. Read each step's live height before placing; the 16-variant grid should reserve 84px rows (the Bangla 2-line case).

A11Y / Tabs. role=tablist on TabList, role=tab + aria-selected + aria-controls on each item, role=tabpanel + aria-labelledby + tabindex=0 on the panel. Roving tabindex: ONE tab stop for the whole list (active tab tabindex=0, others -1); ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move focus, Home/End jump; activation is MANUAL (Enter/Space) so the admin order board does not fire a request per arrow press. Disabled = aria-disabled, stays in the arrow sequence, keeps `_focus`. Count pill is aria-hidden and folded into the name ('Reviews, 128 items'). Tabs are never the only route to URL-worthy content: PDP tabs update the hash (#reviews); admin status tabs are real routes (/orders?status=pending). On mount and change the active tab scrolls into view (inline: nearest; smooth, or auto under reduced motion).

A11Y / Accordion. <h3> (PDP) or <h2> (checkout) wrapping a real <button aria-expanded aria-controls>; panel is role=region aria-labelledby the button and uses the `hidden` attribute when closed (height:0 leaves focusable children reachable). Enter and Space toggle natively; arrow keys do NOT move between headers. allowMultiple=true on the PDP, false on checkout and FAQ; no live region on toggle. Disabled item stays rendered and focusable with aria-disabled so the section's existence is discoverable - hence `_focus` is kept on Disabled. The whole header is one target >= 56 x FILL; chevron is aria-hidden.

A11Y / Stepper. <nav aria-label='Checkout progress'> around an <ol>; aria-current=step on the current <li>; connectors aria-hidden; visible numbers aria-hidden; the hidden `_sr-status` line is aria-live=polite ('Step 2 of 3: Delivery method'). Only Complete steps may be <button>s with a composed name ('Step 1, Contact and delivery, completed. Edit.'); Upcoming steps are <span>, never disabled buttons. State is carried by SHAPE (filled+check / outlined+number / muted outlined+number / outlined+alert) and weight, never colour alone; Error also carries the failure in the description text and a page-level Alert.

MOTION / Tabs. Indicator slides between tabs over base 200ms standard cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1) as a shared layout transition (the bar is one element moving, not two bars fading); panel crossfades over fast 120ms. Reduced motion: bar jumps, panel swaps instantly. Pill: the surface pill slides the same way. Hover: fill swap only (Underline -> color/bg/subtle with top-corner radius/md; Pill -> color/bg/surface); pressed: `_scrim` 12% + scale(0.98). Spring is forbidden.

MOTION / Accordion. Chevron rotation 0 -> 180 over base 200ms standard (this is the `rotation` field on the Chevron layer: 0 on Collapsed/Disabled, 180 on Expanded). Panel open = grid-template-rows 0fr -> 1fr over base 200ms standard + opacity 0 -> 1 over fast 120ms delayed 40ms; close is the reverse. Reduced motion: NO height animation and NO rotation - panel appears instantly and the glyph swaps to icon/caret-up (same Phosphor family; it is `icon/caret-down` with rotation 180 in Figma, a real caret-up glyph in code). Checkout: only the base height transition. Spring is forbidden, specifically here.

MOTION / Stepper. On advance the completing indicator crossfades to color/bg/brand and the check draws over fast 120ms; the connector after it fills left-to-right (scaleX from the left origin) over base 200ms standard. Reduced motion: both instant. No spring, no bounce, no scale, no confetti, no sound, no haptic - this is the surface where a parent decides whether to hand over money. A Complete step used as a button gets `_scrim` 8% on its indicator and an underlined label on hover, 12% pressed, `_focus` at radius/md around the whole step.

BANGLA / Tabs. Strategy SCROLL (list) + GROW (item); no wrap, no truncation. Measured PDP set: Description 118 -> বিবরণ 92, Specifications 142 -> স্পেসিফিকেশন 148, Age guidance 130 -> বয়স নির্দেশিকা 152, Reviews (128) 150 -> রিভিউ (128) 136; totals 612 / 600 with 3 x 24 gaps - both overflow 390, so the scroller exists in both builds. Label is nowrap (WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT). Bangla instances bind Bangla/Tabs/Label (15 / 184%) and Bangla/Tabs/Label-Active; the 44px item leaves 44 - 27.6 = 16.4px headroom.

BANGLA / Accordion. Strategy WRAP: title up to 2 lines, subtitle up to 2 lines, panel unbounded. 'Delivery & returns' -> 'ডেলিভারি ও রিটার্ন' fits one line at 274px text width; 'Age guidance and safety information' -> 'বয়স নির্দেশিকা ও নিরাপত্তা তথ্য' wraps to 2 lines at Bangla/Mobile/h4 (16 x 1.35 x 1.15 = 24.8px/line) = 50px block, header grows to 82px (106 with a subtitle). Header is HUG with Min height 56 precisely so this growth is absorbed. Titles capped at 40 Bangla characters - a third line is a content defect. The panel grows freely; the 0fr -> 1fr technique needs no Bangla measurement.

BANGLA / Stepper. Horizontal WRAP at 2 lines inside min-width 88 (labels capped at 16 Bangla characters: 'ডেলিভারি পদ্ধতি' 126px -> 2 lines -> step 84 tall; 'পেমেন্ট ও রিভিউ' 128px -> 2 lines); frame counter axis is TOP so one tall step moves no indicator. Longer labels switch the whole stepper to Vertical, where Label is FILL and wraps freely and the in-rail connector stretches. Description 'Standard · ৳80 · 2–3 days' -> 'স্ট্যান্ডার্ড · ৳80 · ২-৩ দিন': the price keeps Western digits (data), the duration uses Bengali numerals (prose) - the data/prose boundary inside one string. Step numbers are ALWAYS Western (binding decision 8).

TOUCH / Tabs: items 44 x >= 72 pass; adjacent items are 24 (Underline) or 8 (Pill) apart so targets never overlap; the 24px `_fade` is pointer-events none. Accordion: the header row is the target, >= 56 x FILL. Stepper: non-interactive steps need no target; a Complete step as a button is >= 88 x 78 (Horizontal) or FILL x >= 56 (Vertical); the 28px indicator is never a target on its own and carries no `_hit44` (it would overlap the connector). No component in this manifest uses `_hit44` or `_aria-label`.

GRID / canvas placement. Tabs/Item: 6 variants, 118 x 44 each, 3 columns (State) x 2 rows (Variant), 40px gaps - Pill Active carries e1, allow its shadow. Accordion/Item: 6 variants at 358 wide; row 1 Boxed (56 / ~144 / 56), row 2 Flush (57 / ~145 / 57); use the LIVE Expanded height + 40 for the row pitch. Stepper/Step: 16 variants; Horizontal rows at 88 x ~78 (reserve 84), Vertical rows at 358 x 56; 40px gaps. Layout frames: Tabs 390 x ~140, Tabs / Pill 334 x 52 (HUG), Accordion 358 x ~303, Accordion / Checkout 358 x ~258, Stepper 358 x ~78, Stepper / Vertical 358 x ~248, Stepper / Dot 560 x ~57 - all heights DERIVE from live text wrap; place on one vertical run with >= 40px gaps and assert no bounding-box intersection.

DOCUMENTATION INSTANCES for the lead (beyond the one Bangla entry per set): `Tabs / two-up` - a 358-wide TabList with two Underline items set to FILL width (the Drawer-footer exception, instance not variant); `Tabs / admin order board` - Underline items 'All (42) / Pending (12) / Verification (3) / Booked / Delivered' with showCount on the first three; `Accordion/Item / bn long title` (defined above); `Stepper / Bangla checkout` - the `Stepper` frame with labels যোগাযোগ / ডেলিভারি পদ্ধতি / পেমেন্ট ও রিভিউ and `_sr-status` 'ধাপ ২ / ৩: ডেলিভারি পদ্ধতি'; `Stepper/Step / complete as button` - Horizontal Numbered Complete with focusVisible=true.

BUILD ORDER. 1) Create the 11 newTextStyles (Latin/Stepper/Number with OpenType tnum ON). 2) Build `Accordion/BodyPlaceholder` (plain component) - `Accordion/Item`'s bodySlot swap cannot be set before it exists. 3) Build `Tabs/Item` (6). 4) Build `Accordion/Item` (6) - needs Badge (exists) and BodyPlaceholder. 5) Build `Stepper/Step` (16). 6) Build the 7 layout frames from instances, in the order listed. 7) Re-check: `_indicator` is a layer not a stroke and paints above the TabList `_rule`; Chevron rotation 180 only on Expanded; Vertical steps' `_connector` is FILL height; no icon anywhere carries a stroke; no structural wrapper (TabList, TabPanel, TextBlock, Rail, ConnectorSlot, Panel, Header, every layout frame except `Tabs / Pill`) has a fill.
